#Setup

### Set Project Variables 
```{r set project variables}
Project <- "LOW"
DataIn <- file.path("..","Data", "ProcessedData")
CalibData <- file.path("..","Data", "CalibData")
DataOut <- file.path("..","Data", "ProcessedData")

FileID <- "fit"

FileEncode <- "UTF-8" #guess_encoding says 'ASCII"

Delimiter <- ","

HeaderRows <- 0

#conversions
# us_s = 1000000
photons_umol = 6.022E17
A2_m2 = 1E20


#set colours
TempColours = c("black","violet",  "blue", "darkgreen", "green", "orange", "red", "darkred")

names(TempColours) <- c(2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28)

TempColours
```


```{r read Chlamy_damping}
Chlamy_damping <- readRDS(file.path(DataIn, "LOW_Chlamy_dampingYear.Rds", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)) |>
  mutate(NaCl_opt = as.numeric(NaCl_opt)
  )

```



```{r plots_dampingindex}

Chlamy_damping |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = PulseSpace_s, y = DampingIndex, colour = as.factor(NaCl_mM))) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Temp_C), cols = vars(Strain)) +
  theme_bw()

Chlamy_damping |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = PulseSpace_s, y = DampingIndex, colour = as.factor(NaCl_mM))) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Strain), cols = vars(TempDiff_C)) +
  theme_bw()

Chlamy_damping |>
  filter(PulseSpace_s == 4) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = NaCl_mM, y = DampingIndex)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Strain), cols = vars(TempDiff_C)) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r NaCl_opt_growth tag}
Chlamy_damping <- Chlamy_damping |>
  mutate(NaCl_opt_growth = case_when(NaCl_mM == NaCl_opt ~ 1,
                                     NaCl_mM == 700 ~ 1,
                                     .default = 0)
  )
```



```{r aov}


Chlamy_aovfullinteract <- aov(DampingIndex ~ Strain * LightLevel_ue * Temp_C * NaCl_mM,  data = Chlamy_damping)

summary(Chlamy_aovfullinteract)

# Chlamy_aovinteract <- aov(DampingIndex ~ Strain * LightLevel_ue + Temp_C + NaCl_mM,  data = Chlamy_damping)
# summary(Chlamy_aovinteract)


ChlamyStrains_aovinteract <-  Chlamy_damping |>
  nest(data = -c("Strain")) |>    
  mutate(Strains_aovinteract = map(data, ~aov(DampingIndex ~ LightLevel_ue * Temp_C * NaCl_mM, data = .))
  ) |>
  mutate(Strains_aovinteract_Param = map(Strains_aovinteract, tidy)) |>
  unnest(Strains_aovinteract_Param, names_sep = "_") |>
  filter(Strains_aovinteract_Param_p.value <= 0.05) |>
  select(-c(data, Strains_aovinteract ))

kable(ChlamyStrains_aovinteract)

ChlamyStrainsNaCl_opt_aov <- Chlamy_damping |>
  nest(data = -c("Strain")) |>
  mutate(Strains_aov = map(data, ~aov(DampingIndex ~ LightLevel_ue + Temp_C + NaCl_opt_growth, data = .))
         ) |>
   mutate(Strains_aov_Param = map(Strains_aov, tidy)) |>
  unnest(Strains_aov_Param,  names_sep = "_") |>
  filter(Strains_aov_Param_p.value <= 0.05) |>
  select(!matches("Strains_aovinteract")) |>
  select(!c(data, Strains_aov)) |>
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "Strains_aov_")) |>
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "Param_"))

kable(ChlamyStrainsNaCl_opt_aov)
```
